specification: src/weather-evidence-record.mjs (the evidence design: raw sources age out; derived records, states, outcomes and grades are kept)
sourceRetentionMaxDaysBasis: The evidence design's law: a raw source record is kept 14 days (weather-evidence-record.mjs DEFAULT_SOURCE_RETENTION_DAYS). The window is never longer than this.
sourceRetentionMinDaysBasis: A derived record's source is read back for the day's rescoring; two days keep the sources of every forecast that can still settle in the cycle's longest horizon (48 h).
storeBudgetBytesBasis: What the weather content tree may hold on Cold Red Gate: 1 GiB of the 3.8 GB the host had free on 2026-10-18, beside the logs and the other state. The retention window is the longest the measured growth lets the store stay within it (weather-retention.mjs retentionWindow).
gcAfterGrowthBytesBasis: Garbage is reclaimed when the store has grown by this much since the last gc, as well as after any expiry: 64 MiB is about four hours at the measured 393 MB a day (2026-10-18, 167 MB written in 10.2 h), so a gc never reads more than a few hours of new packs. Measured on a copy of the real store with a 128 MB heap: a minor gc takes 11.6 s and 238 MB resident, a major gc 13 s and 245 MB.
expiryDaysPerCycleBasis: A cycle drops the dated source refs of up to this many days older than the window, so a window that shrinks is caught up in a day, not a month.
derivedWorkingWindowDaysBasis: Measured by reading every caller of loadWeatherEvidence and readEvidenceRecord (2026-10-19): none loads a derived record older than the cycle that made it. The hourly projection and the participation snapshot read the latest cycle's record (at most 15 minutes old); scoring reads the pending forecasts' own rows, not the records; grading, calibration, refits and readiness read resolved.jsonl, the grades tree and the station-science head; only the offline replay (apps/replay-station-weather-science.mjs) and the on-demand weatherEvidence tool name older ids. The longest live lookback is 15 minutes, so a week keeps 672 times that for audit; an aged record still serves detail 'used', and detail 'full' says WEATHER_STATE_AGED_OUT once its revision is reclaimed.
derivedAgingPerCycleBasis: A cycle ages at most this many derived records past the working window, so a window that shrinks is caught up in a day (about 90 cycles' records are made a day) and no cycle reads more than 200 records of 1.7 MB.
derivedArchiveWindowDaysBasis: Twice the working window: an aged record (about 40 KB, 24 MB a day across the cycles) is audit evidence no live reader names, so it is kept on the host for a further week and then leaves with its day as one archive for R2 (weather-archive.mjs). The window is never shorter than the working window plus the source retention's slack, so a day is whole before it is archived.
archiveDaysPerCycleBasis: A cycle archives at most one day (about 90 records, 4 MB aged) and verifies it by importing it into a scratch store, so no cycle reads more than a day of aged records; a window that shrinks is caught up at a day a cycle.
majorEveryMsBasis: The file section's own default (content-tree-store gc): a major gc, the one that reclaims garbage among tenured nodes, once in seven days; every other gc is a minor one that reads only what was written since.
graceMsBasis: A node younger than six hours is never removed, so a tree put by a writer and not yet named by its ref is safe (a cycle is at most 14 minutes).
